lane: SQL + Edge + Admin: A6 follow-up (monthly 1 USD eval budget, Astrology eval adapter so Astrology can pass the release gate)
goal: Owner decision 14/11: the AI eval budget becomes 1 USD per calendar month (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), counting only runs started in the current month, with the same reservation, advisory lock and stale-run expiry as A6. Astrology insight gets an eval adapter: a new migration seeds fixed synthetic charts (calculated by packages/astrology-core from invented inputs, facts only, no birth data), extends ai_eval_case_input to accept {question, chartKey, theme} for astrology_insight, lets start_ai_eval_run accept Astrology sets (charts attached to each case) and seeds a 'Bộ mẫu có sẵn' Astrology set with 2 crisis and 5 normal cases. admin-ai-eval-run runs Astrology draft and active versions through the real astrology_report model route with the same request and response contract as ai-astrology-insight. Nothing is applied or deployed by the agent.
successCriteria: New migration 20261114090100_ai_eval_monthly_budget_astrology.sql (applied migrations untouched) sets ai_eval_budget_cap_micro to 1 000 000 micro-USD, adds nilaza_private.ai_eval_month_start, makes ai_eval_budget count only runs started since the start of the current Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh month and return monthStart, resetsAt, period and timeZone; reservation, advisory lock and 15-minute stale-run expiry are unchanged.

ai_eval_case_input accepts astrology_insight cases {question (<= 500), chartKey (one of the seeded synthetic charts, default eval_chart_a), theme (one of the six focus themes, default open_reflection)} and still refuses personal data and unknown keys; every other feature branch is byte-for-byte the A6 logic.

start_ai_eval_run no longer refuses astrology_insight; Astrology case rows carry the synthetic chart facts; a run still needs a crisis case and a normal case; the budget check refuses (NZE03) instead of clamping a reservation.
A 'Bộ mẫu có sẵn' Astrology eval set (2 crisis VI/EN, 5 normal) is seeded only when missing, and every seeded case input passes ai_eval_case_input.

admin-ai-eval-run: astrology.ts builds a nilaza.astrology.ai-insight.invoke.v1 invocation from the synthetic chart, validates it with validateAstrologyAiInvocation, requires an active astrology_report route with the astrology_ai_insight_v1 schema and an active prompt (draft override for prompt runs), calls generateWithModelRoute with the same system prompt (shared module) and user message as ai-astrology-insight, and checks the answer with makeAstrologyAiResponseEnvelope + validateAstrologyAiResponse; crisis cases never reach a model.

Admin: Chạy thử & chấm điểm shows 'Ngân sách tháng này: còn X / 1 USD, đặt lại ngày 1', the exhausted message names the monthly reset, Astrology cases get chart and theme pickers, and the release gate no longer says Astrology has no adapter.

Deno tests (adapter + existing), deno check, admin:test, validate-admin-contract, validate-admin-workflow-catalog, validate:backend, supabase:check, astrology:ai-contract:check and a PGlite replay of all migrations (monthly rollover, Astrology seed valid, Astrology run start accepted, A6 checks) pass; preflight --ci passes (Windows CRLF-only failures excepted).
untouchedSurfaces: Applied migrations (including 20261113110000) are not edited; the changed functions are redefined in the new migration.
publish_astrology_prompt_pair stays ungated in this step (recommendation recorded for a later step).
supabase/functions/_shared/model-router.ts, providers and the astrology contract modules are used as-is.
ai-astrology-insight behaviour is unchanged: only asModelJson and systemPrompt move to a shared module with identical text.
Mobile app, Tarot, Oracle, Council, Daily and persona chat runtime are unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Admin › Chạy thử & chấm điểm (budget pill, Astrology set editor and run), publish dialogs in Tính năng AI and Prompt & phiên bản (gate text); Edge Function admin-ai-eval-run (POST).
impact.dataWrite: No new table or column. New migration redefines four private/public functions, adds two private helper functions and seeds one Astrology eval set (only when missing).
impact.backendContract: list_ai_eval_sets / list_ai_eval_runs budget object gains monthStart, resetsAt, period, timeZone; capMicro becomes 1000000. start_ai_eval_run accepts astrology_insight. Error codes unchanged.
impact.adminVisibility: Monthly remaining budget with reset date; Astrology runs, results and gate status like other features.
impact.privacySafety: Astrology eval charts are calculated from invented dates and a city-centre place and contain only chart facts (no date, time, place or coordinates); case questions refuse email/phone and are checked by the runtime focus rules; crisis cases are answered in code without a model call; strict trace redaction.
impact.observability: Eval model calls trace through generateWithModelRoute with feature astrology_report, metadata evalRunId/evalCaseId/evalVariant and adminEval true.
impact.rollback: Re-create ai_eval_budget_cap_micro, ai_eval_budget, ai_eval_case_input and start_ai_eval_run from 20261113110000 (one create or replace each); delete the seeded Astrology set; redeploy the previous admin-ai-eval-run.

skillReview.evidence: Record and preflight before the first edit; new migration only; PGlite and local tests; Owner applies and deploys by hash.

skillReview.name: nilaza-ai-runtime
skillReview.evidence: Astrology evals use the real astrology_report route through generateWithModelRoute with the runtime's own system prompt, user message and response validation; crisis cases never reach a model; only synthetic chart facts are sent.

dependencyReview.evidence: PostgreSQL date_trunc / at time zone already used in earlier migrations; PGlite only in the session scratchpad; no dependency added.

securityReview.authzRls: No new table or grant to clients; new private helpers are revoked from public, anon and authenticated; start_ai_eval_run stays service_role only and the Edge Function keeps its own capability check.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Synthetic charts come from invented inputs and carry only chart facts; questions are synthetic and refuse email, phone and date/time/place patterns.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secret read or logged; the function logs no case or answer text.
securityReview.externalInput: chartKey and theme are enum-checked in SQL; the adapter re-validates the whole invocation with the runtime validator before any model call.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Owner applies 20261114090100 after 20261113110000 by hash, then redeploys admin-ai-eval-run (ai-astrology-insight redeploy optional: same behaviour, shared module).
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if PGlite, Deno tests, deno check or Admin tests fail, or if a crisis case could reach a model.

managerTestPath: After the Owner applies 20261114090100 and redeploys admin-ai-eval-run: open Admin › Chạy thử & chấm điểm, the pill shows 'Ngân sách tháng này: còn … / 1 USD, đặt lại ngày 1'; choose Đọc sâu Chiêm tinh, open 'Bộ mẫu có sẵn' (2 crisis, 5 normal cases with sample charts), save an astrology_report prompt draft or an Astrology feature draft, run the set; the safety layer passes when the model answers match the Astrology contract; the publish dialog then allows publishing.
residualRisk: PGlite is not Supabase; no real model call was made. Astrology runs need an active astrology_report route with the astrology_ai_insight_v1 schema (set in Admin), like the real function; without it every normal case fails with astrology:route_not_ready. Astrology crisis cases pass on the endpoint's own pre-model refusal (blocked topic self_harm); the app's Astrology crisis message has no 115 number, unlike the Tarot/Chat support card — recommend aligning it. publish_astrology_prompt_pair stays ungated (recommend gating both VI and EN drafts in a later migration). 1 USD per month allows by reservation about 5 starter-set feature runs, 8 VI or 12 EN prompt runs; unused reservation is released when a run finishes. Runs still running at a month boundary keep their reservation counted in the new month until they finish or expire. scripts/ai-answer-endpoints.test.mjs has two Tarot failures that also occur on origin/main cb32621 (not caused by this change).
